notes.title: Extended PLAYTEST IS OUT!!
notes.notes:
EXTENDED PLAYTEST

For those who have stayed on we just want to really thank you for holding on and staying with us! We have been working very hard to fix alot of the problems that we have seen and also added abit of something for everyone. This is what we have done for this update

Animation
-Better Walk
-Better Run

Settings Menu
-Sensitivity Adjustments
-Keybinding adjustments

Sounds
-New improved Zombie sounds when you are detected
-Improved UI art 
-New voice work done for the 2 characters
 -Belica
 -Martin

2 New levels of for the medical area is done

There is still much much more we have done and we have fixed in the time you have given us. Since the last time we met we have been through hell and are heading back again to better improve the game.  We continue to ask for your support and patience as we move forward slowly but steadily.
